environment_setting: Country B, Capital City, where a new Act has been passed requiring public officials to implement transitional provisions within a strict timeline.
norm_base: Public Officials Failing to make transitional provisions for implementing the Act Administrative consequences

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: Ensure smooth implementation of the new Act

legitimate.legitimate_action: Drafting and implementing transitional provisions for the Act
legitimate.benefits: Compliance with the law, professional recognition, and public trust

illegal.illegal_action: Failing to draft and implement transitional provisions for the Act
illegal.costs: Administrative consequences such as reprimand, demotion, or suspension

character_profile.name: Emily Carter
character_profile.goal: Support the implementation of the Act

legitimate.legitimate_action: Assisting John Smith in drafting transitional provisions
legitimate.costs: Increased workload and potential conflicts with colleagues

illegal.illegal_action: Neglecting to assist in drafting transitional provisions
illegal.costs: Administrative consequences such as a formal warning or reduced performance evaluation

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: Ensure legal compliance of the Act's implementation

legitimate.legitimate_action: Providing legal guidance to ensure the transitional provisions comply with the Act
legitimate.benefits: Maintaining professional integrity and avoiding legal disputes

illegal.illegal_action: Failing to provide legal guidance for the transitional provisions
illegal.costs: Administrative consequences such as reprimand or loss of credibility
